topic: Friction and how it affects motion
key_concepts: Friction is a force that opposes motion
Friction occurs when surfaces of two objects rub against each other
Friction acts opposite to the direction of an object's motion
Friction causes moving objects to slow down and stop
Air friction or air resistance opposes movement of objects in air
Smooth or wet surfaces produce less friction
Friction is useful in daily activities such as holding objects, sitting, and walking
Friction can be reduced by applying lubricant
Some activities like skating need less friction
